description: The degree of a vertex in the tree described by a Prüfer code. Degree is one plus the number of times the vertex appears. In code 2,3, vertex 2 has degree 2 and vertex 1 has degree 1. The vertex must lie from 1 to n. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/prufer-degree

title: Prufer Degree
